scope: Actual localized diagnostic experiment; original full-B physics retained; no host integration or optimizer update.

noninterference.gates: Exact shape/dtype/raw-byte equality for full saved values and selected first-order products; same actual candidate direction/cotangent.

direction.recipe: Original accepted proposal dtheta=0.2*z_theta; dqv=0.02*qv_baseline*z_qv. Original block22 is not frozen; no further normalization.
direction.support: All original 512 columns in this block; fixed rest/MU/PH/geometry/land/surface.
direction.input_rule: x(epsilon)=x_baseline+epsilon*delta; each endpoint rebuilt from baseline once.

local_FD.primary_outputs: Target row all39 levels raw12+finish5, eight differentiable RTTOV profile fields (66 layers/67 P_HALF), seven actual target BTs and fixed-support target Huber sum. All 33 field categories must pass at one common epsilon. Full-B values/tangents retained as separate diagnostics.
local_FD.acceptance: All primary outputs must pass at a common epsilon; preserve every failed field/epsilon and branch change. Numerical agreement does not certify unrecorded branches.
local_FD.support_gate: Original target seven-channel mask/quality and all66 CFRAC values retained; record profile topology/finish/cleanup and captured activation/schedule branch comparisons.
local_FD.cost: Same baseline observation, original fixed target weights and KMA-BT Huber sigma/delta. Target cost contribution, not a new full-domain objective evaluation.

diagnostics: Actual activation entrance after state update/reclass
Raw post-nonnegative/pre-reservoir rate, capped and gated rate
Post-pcact state/qs1, pcond/complete evaporation, raw/final NCCN
Threshold/final DSD gates and exact cap ties
Pair schedule/microphysics ordinals and dt; all512 main/ice schedules
Target and full-B boolean signatures; quality/mask/CFRAC/profile topology at FD endpoints
observation: Reuse pinned native profile/writer/actual RTTOV-K. A target-only RTTOV batch may be used after comparison with the saved full-batch target BT/profile; full-B KDM is mandatory.
limits: Historical raw number coordinates remain conditional, not physical-unit certification.
No forecast skill, full-domain new experiment, host cycle, optimization or closed physical-budget claim.
Failure of a directional check is retained; no tolerance or moment floor adjustment.
revision_reason: Before any centered-FD endpoint, include each differentiable profile coordinate in the common-epsilon criterion so large NC/BT signals cannot hide a missing weak pressure or temperature path.
